definition: Application-layer gross margin after inference cost, constructed from reported ARR, token spend and unit inference costs (the brief's gap 4).

direction_rule.rationale: Placeholder until the series exists; bands are set with the first observation.

name: Application gross margin net of inference (model tax)
timing_rationale: Leading: the model tax squeezes application margins before application valuations adjust.
unpublished_reason: Not measurable from free sources: Artificial Analysis now gives list price per token, but a margin needs each app's token volume and revenue, neither public, and list price overstates what large apps pay under committed-use discounts; SemiAnalysis unit costs and The Information's app financials are paid (stubs off).
why_it_matters: The model tax in one number: whether falling token prices are retained by apps or passed through.
